_comment: Crest Emporium (a Pokemon Rejuvenation add-on by KolinKat). Crests left out: field-based ones (Froslass, Trevenant, Porygon-Z, Lumineon, Kecleon, Furfrou, Wormadam, Vivillon), Mascot, Grumpig (disabled in Emporium), and Aevian/regional parts.

ambipom_crest.name: Ambipom Crest
ambipom_crest.desc: Moves of 60 power or less hit twice; the second hit deals a quarter of the damage.

aurorus_crest.name: Aurorus Crest
aurorus_crest.desc: Sets a 3-turn Aurora Veil on entry. Attackers get frostbite: they take Ice damage each turn and their contact moves turn Ice-type.

avalugg_crest.name: Avalugg Crest
avalugg_crest.desc: Starts hail on entry. Each turn in hail or snow, Sp. Def gains 10% of its Defense.

beautifly_crest.name: Beautifly Crest
beautifly_crest.desc: Sp. Atk +20%, Speed +30%. Attacks steal 20% of the foe's Sp. Atk. HP-draining moves are 50% stronger.

bellossom_crest.name: Bellossom Crest
bellossom_crest.desc: Copies dance moves used by others, and its dance moves gain extra effects.

cacturne_crest.name: Cacturne Crest
cacturne_crest.desc: Lays Spikes when hit. +1 priority on its first turn and for damaging moves of 60 power or less.

carnivine_crest.name: Carnivine Crest
carnivine_crest.desc: Traps foes it hits or that hit it in a Snap Trap, weakening their attacks and sapping their HP.

chatot_crest.name: Chatot Crest
chatot_crest.desc: Sound moves are 20% stronger and always confuse. Copies sound moves used by others.

chesnaught_crest.name: Chesnaught Crest
chesnaught_crest.desc: Spiky Shield raises its defenses by 50% for a turn, and it heals from foes hurt by the spikes.

chimecho_crest.name: Chimecho Crest
chimecho_crest.desc: Defense and Sp. Def +50%. Rings a Heal Bell every turn, curing and healing its whole party.

comfey_crest.name: Comfey Crest
comfey_crest.desc: HP-draining moves also heal its ally by half as much. Draining is stronger while its ally is at full HP or it's alone.

delibird_crest.name: Delibird Crest
delibird_crest.desc: Foes fall asleep when Delibird switches in. Present becomes a 90-power Ice move that hits the weaker defense and raises all of Delibird's stats by 20%.

delphox_crest.name: Delphox Crest
delphox_crest.desc: Mystical Fire becomes Psychic-type when that's more effective, and deals 20% more to foes holding an item.

drifblim_crest.name: Drifblim Crest
drifblim_crest.desc: Burns itself on entry and heals while burned. Immune to Fire-type moves.

dunsparce_crest.name: Dunsparce Crest
dunsparce_crest.desc: Moves with unlikely side effects hit harder; moves with likely side effects make it take less damage. Restores 1/16 HP each turn.

dustox_crest.name: Dustox Crest
dustox_crest.desc: Defense and Sp. Def +30%. Poisons attackers, or lowers poisoned attackers' stats. Restores 1/16 HP each turn.

eldegoss_crest.name: Eldegoss Crest
eldegoss_crest.desc: Raises Defense every turn, gaining more effects the higher it gets. When hit, loses its Defense boosts to punish the attacker.

emolga_crest.name: Emolga Crest
emolga_crest.desc: Rides wind moves back at the attacker as Electric moves. Uses Discharge when its side uses Tailwind. Offenses grow with its Speed.

frosmoth_crest.name: Frosmoth Crest
frosmoth_crest.desc: Blocks the first Fire-type attack after switching in, hurting the attacker. Takes 25% less damage from physical moves.

girafarig_crest.name: Girafarig Crest
girafarig_crest.desc: Girafarig attacks twice, the second hit with the inverse type. Farigiraf's attacks gain the inverse type as a second type when it helps.

gourgeist_crest.name: Gourgeist Crest
gourgeist_crest.desc: Every 2 turns it plays Trick-or-Treat after moving, with effects depending on its size.

greninja_crest.name: Greninja Crest
greninja_crest.desc: Water Shuriken takes on whichever of the foe's own types hits it hardest.

kricketune_crest.name: Kricketune Crest
kricketune_crest.desc: Special moves use Attack, and its other stats gain 25% of its Attack. Physical and sound moves raise its and its ally's stats.

lanturn_crest.name: Lanturn Crest
lanturn_crest.desc: On switch-in, spotlights a foe and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk by 20%, adding the same amount to Lanturn's defenses. Restores 1/16 HP each turn.

leavanny_crest.name: Leavanny Crest
leavanny_crest.desc: On switch-in, spends 25% HP to make a substitute for itself or a weaker ally.

lurantis_crest.name: Lurantis Crest
lurantis_crest.desc: Against a foe with a type that's super effective on it, gains +1 priority and 50% more damage.

maractus_crest.name: Maractus Crest
maractus_crest.desc: Physical moves use Sp. Atk. Weather and its first move make it Fire type (Sp. Def boost) or Rock type (Defense boost).

masquerain_crest.name: Masquerain Crest
masquerain_crest.desc: Turns its Flying type into Water but keeps Flying STAB and resistances. Gains Aqua Ring.

minior_crest.name: Minior Crest
minior_crest.desc: With its shell broken, its Rock moves switch to its core color's type when that's more effective.

mismagius_crest.name: Mismagius Crest
mismagius_crest.desc: Gains the Fairy type. Hex calls a follow-up move depending on its move slot.

mothim_crest.name: Mothim Crest
mothim_crest.desc: Speed and its higher offense +30%. Attacks hit the weaker defense. Secret Power calls a follow-up move depending on its move slot.

octillery_crest.name: Octillery Crest
octillery_crest.desc: Takes less damage from foes that move first. Locks on to attackers, making its ball and bomb moves always crit and hit harder against them.

pachirisu_crest.name: Pachirisu Crest
pachirisu_crest.desc: Its defenses rise the lower its offenses are. Attacks deal extra damage equal to 10% of its defense, healing if the target is paralyzed.

parasect_crest.name: Parasect Crest
parasect_crest.desc: Blocks the first Fire-type attack after switching in, hurting the attacker. Damaging moves have a 30% chance to poison, burn or paralyze, and drain 20% of a statused foe's Attack.

pyroar_crest.name: Pyroar Crest
pyroar_crest.desc: Uses Noble Roar on switch-in. Special moves use its Attack boosts.

qwilfish_crest.name: Qwilfish Crest
qwilfish_crest.desc: Qwilfish: Aqua Ring on entry, Rough Skin, Sp. Def +20%. Overqwil: contact attackers are hurt and it saps their HP, more if they're poisoned.

seaking_crest.name: Seaking Crest
seaking_crest.desc: Makes it rain when Seaking enters battle. Attack +20%.

sigilyph_crest.name: Sigilyph Crest
sigilyph_crest.desc: Every 2 turns it gives itself a status condition, then passes it to a healthy foe.

smeargle_crest.name: Smeargle Crest
smeargle_crest.desc: Smeargle's types and stats are shaped by its moveset.

stunfisk_crest.name: Stunfisk Crest
stunfisk_crest.desc: Gains Water STAB and resistances. Uses Discharge when hit. Paralyzed foes get -1 priority.

tropius_crest.name: Tropius Crest
tropius_crest.desc: Moves of 60 power or less are 50% stronger. Grows a berry that cures status, softens a hit at full HP, or heals and raises a stat.

tyrantrum_crest.name: Tyrantrum Crest
tyrantrum_crest.desc: All attacks of 120 power or less become 120 power, but lock it into a rampage.

unfezant_crest.name: Unfezant Crest
unfezant_crest.desc: Special moves use Attack. +1 crit ratio for its side. Crits lower the foe's Attack (male) or heal the attacker (female).

unown_crest.name: Unown Crest
unown_crest.desc: Hidden Power hits once for every party member, using their Hidden Power types. Resists its party's Hidden Power types. Attack boosts its other stats.

vanilluxe_crest.name: Vanilluxe Crest
vanilluxe_crest.desc: In hail or snow, Speed and Ice moves grow stronger with the weather's remaining turns. Water moves extend the hail instead of hurting it.

vileplume_crest.name: Vileplume Crest
vileplume_crest.desc: Damaging moves have a 30% chance to poison, burn or paralyze. Takes 20% less damage from statused foes.

watchog_crest.name: Watchog Crest
watchog_crest.desc: Defenses rise the slower it is than its foe. Inaccurate moves become more accurate and more powerful.

xatu_crest.name: Xatu Crest
xatu_crest.desc: Keeps Future Sight active. When Future Sight knocks out a foe, Xatu raises its defenses and heals.

female.furret_crest: Female: Attack and Sp. Atk copy its Speed, and physical Normal moves become Ground-type.
female.sunflora_crest: Female: summons sun that lasts while Sunflora is out, and gains Fire resistances and immunity to Fire moves.
female.sawsbuck_crest: Female: Normal type becomes Fairy, Fire, Ghost or Ice by season; its first move matches and gains a seasonal side effect.
female.plusle_crest: Female: above 50% HP, Minun helps out: takes half damage and follows each move with the move two slots away.
female.minun_crest: Female: above 50% HP, Plusle helps out: takes half damage and follows each move with the move two slots away.
